[[File:Pit.png|thumb|250px|Pit]] '''Pit''' (Japanese: '''ビット''' ''Bit'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[Hoopa — The Mischief Pokémon]]''. He lives in [[Arche Valley]] and is a childhood friend of [[Baraz]] and [[Meray]]. He grew up with Baraz, Meray, {{an|Hoopa}}, [[Lucianne]] and [[Kevie]]. One day, he and his friends tried to help [[Old Man Dom]] by having Hoopa make rain appear to stop the drought. This didn't work however, as Hoopa misunderstood and let it rain candy from Mira's store instead. They were punished for this by {{OBP|Mira|Hoopa — The Mischief Pokémon}} and had to help her make donuts. They later got in even more trouble when they accidentally broke an ivory statue treasured by Mira. When Mira was about to discover this, Kevie asked Pit to buy them some time. He managed to stop her from discovering what they did, and they tried to glue the statue. They weren't able to make it look like it did before however. Mira ultimately discovered this, but she wasn't mad at them as they had done their best to repair it. Afterwards they all enjoyed the donuts they made together. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{ghost color light}} |ja=古島清孝 ''[[Kiyotaka Furushima]]'' |en=Peter Mills Weiss |ko=심규혁 ''Sim Gyuhyeok''}}
